services.name: Fishing Boat
services.desc: Last Chance Fishing Adventures can take you fishing 12 months of the year! Here is where and when we fish: Crabbing is available within sight of the docks, and there are dozens of reefs and bays to locate some hungry Winter Chinook (Springs). These feisty fish are usually eager to take the hook, and fantastic table fare. This is also the best time of year to find a Pacific Halibut! These large flatfish can weigh over 400 lbs, but 20-60 pounders are the most common. We fish for halibut anywhere from Victoria to Jordan River.
